summary: The Association of Latino Administrators and Superintendents supports a periodic review of the E-Rate program but emphasizes that the review should focus on its core purpose of providing affordable telecommunications and information services to eligible schools and libraries. The Association of Latino Administrators and Superintendents (ALAS) supports preserving the E-Rate program while continuing to improve its administration and reduce burdens on participating schools and libraries. ALAS emphasizes the importance of maintaining affordable, reliable school connectivity for educational opportunities.
